listings.rawTitle: BEau de Provence Eau de Toilette
listings.description: Beginning with a tart top note of grapefruit combined with an irresistible duo of fig and bergamot, this eau de toilette offers a fresh heart note of mint, basil, and ylang-ylang. The base releases nomadic notes of Atlas cedar, Indonesian patchouli, and Javanese sandalwood and vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: Belle De Paris Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Belle de paris is elegantly cloaked in iris, a symbol of chic, and wears its incomparable scent. Its fruity head notes of green mandarin, neroli, and pear brighten a generous heart of iris absolutely adorned with violet and incense. Musk and white cedar form its base.

A cult classic scent defined by a complex blend of luxury notes, for an incomparable and intense fragrance. Rich vetiver, lush oakmoss, and luxurious patchouli are balanced with the soft florally of ylang ylang and rose - a bold blend that stirs the senses and spirit in subtle, pleasing ways. A uniquely intense and non-conformist fragrance that always makes a statement, aromatics elixir is designed for the true individual.

A refined floral composition that exalts the delicacy of Camelia in all its facets. Sparkling citrus notes masterfully bursts forth with an all-embracing luminosity in the heart notes. The soft seductive amber base nuances seal this romantic and sophisticated fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: White Tea Eau de Toilette Spray 100ml
listings.description: The White Tea Collection celebrates the pleasure of a life finely crafted. Discover the simple joy of defining a moment for yourself and savoring the personal reflection that comes with it. Tailor the world to your own private pleasure. Bottle the spirit, add a touch of serenity, and enjoy. White Tea invites you to share in the beauty that surrounds you every day. Find your moment. White Tea Crisp and vibrant floral with a lingering warmth White Tea is a refined essence with a clean sophistication. A serene landscape layered with bold light. Silky, vibrant, warm. Bursts of mandarin orange trailing into soft, woody musk. Feminine and persuasively soft.

From Elizabeth Arden, the creator several iconic and bestselling fragrance collections, White Tea is an aroma of simple joys and private pleasures. A deeper concentration of the beloved scent, White Tea Eau de Parfum is composed by master perfumers, using exquisite ingredients, Crafted using VivaScentz™ technology which harmonizes key White Tea notes into perfect balance, the fragrance encourages a sense of wellbeing in its wearer. At its heart is rose, both in the rare forms of rose oil and upcycled rose water, as well as hand-harvested mate leaves from South America which lend a fresh, herbal tea signature. It’s rounded out by Venezuelan tonka bean, picked by hand and sun-dried to release its nuanced warmth, amberwood and a trio of musks.

listings.rawTitle: No.4 Under the Palms Eau de Parfum Set
listings.description: This Under the Palms fragrance from our Provenance range invites you to escape to a tropical paradise. Transport yourself to far-flung shores where warm breezes carry the intoxicating scent of neroli, mandarin and orange. A heart of creamy coconut and salty sea notes evokes the feeling of toes in the sand, while a soothing base of vanilla, almond milk and musk envelops you in pure relaxation. This set includes a 48ml bottle and a 9ml travel companion for quick spritzes on the go.

listings.rawTitle: No.2 Neroli Blush Eau de Parfum Set
listings.description: Enhance your moments of relaxation with this Neroli Blush eau de parfum from our Provenance range. Sparkling bergamot and grapefruit mingle with a heart of delicate neroli and jasmine that evokes sun-drenched blossoms. A warm base of vanilla and musk lingers on the skin, creating a captivating trail. Crafted with uplifting cold-pressed orange essential oil and exotic Madagascan vanilla, this fragrance captures the elegance of the Riviera and transports you to sun-kissed shores. This set includes a 48ml bottle and a convenient 9ml travel size, allowing you to enjoy the scent wherever your adventures take you.

listings.rawTitle: No.3 Coastal Breeze Eau de Parfum Set
listings.description: The Coastal Breeze eau de parfum from our Provenance range is an invigorating scent that captures the essence of seaside freshness. This refreshing fragrance opens with crisp notes of cucumber and honeysuckle, followed by a heart of aquatic hyacinth and juicy watermelon. A base of earthy seaweed and clean white musk creates a lingering reminder of coastal walks and revitalising spring days. The fragrances come in both a generous 48ml bottle and a convenient 9ml travel size.

listings.rawTitle: No.6 Sandalwood Haze Eau de Parfum Set
listings.description: Embark on a sensory journey across the globe with the warm and exotic profile of our Provenance Sandalwood Haze fragrance. Woody notes of sandalwood mingle with the vibrant freshness of Mediterranean fruits. A spicy aroma unfolds, revealing a heart of aromatic tea and blackcurrant, leading to a base of earthy galbanum, musk and petitgrain. This set contains both a 48ml bottle and a smaller 9ml bottle, perfect for when you're on the move.

listings.rawTitle: No.1 Citrus Soleil Eau de Parfum Set
listings.description: Escape to the sun-kissed shores of the Mediterranean with Citrus Soleil, a captivating eau de parfum from our Provenance collection. Sicilian lemon oil transports you to a citrus grove, where vibrant notes of mandarin and zesty lemon mingle with the delicate sweetness of orange blossom, jasmine and neroli. A lingering touch of musk adds warmth and depth, evoking the feeling of a summer evening spent in the countryside. This delightful fragrance comes in a convenient set, including both a full-sized bottle and a travel-sized companion for on-the-go adventures.

listings.rawTitle: No.5 Aegean Rose Eau de Parfum Set
listings.description: This Aegean Rose eau de parfum from our Provenance range is crafted using precious ingredients from around the world. Damask rose oil from Turkey adds a touch of floral sophistication, while spicy patchouli oil from Indonesia creates an alluring warmth reminiscent of tropical summer evenings. Mandarin and pink pepper provide a vibrant opening, leading to a delicate heart of plum blossom and peony. A luxurious base of musk and sandalwood anchors the fragrance, creating a captivating aroma that lingers on the skin. This set includes a 48ml bottle, plus a convenient 9ml travel size perfect for taking on adventures.

listings.rawTitle: No.7 Wild Bergamot Eau de Parfum Set
listings.description: An aromatic journey awaits with Wild Bergamot, an uplifting fragrance from our Provenance range that captures the invigorating essence of sun-drenched citrus groves. A vibrant opening of apple, cassis and zesty bergamot awakens the senses, leading to a heart of juniper, basil and bay that evokes a feeling of refreshing clarity. The fragrance unfolds further, revealing a warm and inviting base of musk, amber and oakmoss. This set includes both a 50ml bottle and a convenient 10ml travel size.
